description: The gallery and the buy box of one product.

files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  A product page: a gallery (the main picture and optional thumbnails) beside the buy box (badge, rating, price,
  stock, quantity, add button, shipping and returns notes). Axes: layout (split, stacked), media side, thumbs
  (none, below), buy (full, compact), tone, density.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { ProductDetailLabels } from "./product-detail.types";
  import type { Product } from "./product-card.types";

  export type ProductDetailProps = {
    id: string;
    product?: Product;
    labels: ProductDetailLabels;
    badges: Record<string, string>;
    level?: 1 | 2;
    layout?: "split" | "stacked";
    mediaSide?: "start" | "end";
    thumbs?: "none" | "below";
    buy?: "full" | "compact";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    density?: "default" | "roomy";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
    onadd?: (id: string) => void;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Button from "../compose/Button.svelte";
  import Group from "../compose/Group.svelte";
  import Inline from "../compose/Inline.svelte";
  import List from "../compose/List.svelte";
  import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.svelte";
  import Stack from "../compose/Stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.svelte";
  import NumberField from "../components/number-field.svelte";
  import ProductGallery from "../components/product-gallery.svelte";
  import ProductPrice from "../components/product-price.svelte";
  import Rating from "../components/rating.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { at, tpl } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    product,
    labels,
    badges,
    level = 1,
    layout = "split",
    mediaSide = "start",
    thumbs = "below",
    buy = "full",
    tone = "default",
    density = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
    onadd,
  }: ProductDetailProps = $props();
</script>

{#if !product}
  <SectionFrame id={id} tone={tone} density={density} landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}>
    <EmptyState icon="package" title={labels.empty} />
  </SectionFrame>
{:else}
  <SectionFrame
    id={id}
    title={product?.name}
    lead={product?.summary}
    heading={{ level }}
    layout={(((layout as string) === "split") ? "split" : "stack")}
    media={{ show: true, side: mediaSide, align: "start" }}
    tone={tone}
    density={density}
    landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}
  >
    <Stack gap="4" align="stretch" data-testid="buy-box">
      {#if product?.category}
        <Text size="xs" class="uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground" data-testid="category">
          {product?.category}
        </Text>
      {/if}
      <ProductPrice
        price={product?.price}
        compareAt={product?.compareAt}
        currency={product?.currency}
        badge={(product?.badge ? at(badges, product?.badge) : "")}
        was={labels.was}
      />
      <Group gap="2">
        <Rating value={product?.rating} label={tpl(labels.ratingLabel, product?.rating)} />
        <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {tpl(labels.reviews, product?.reviews)}
        </Text>
      </Group>
      <Text
        size="sm"
        weight="medium"
        class={(product?.inStock ? "text-foreground" : "text-destructive")}
        data-testid="stock"
      >
        {(product?.inStock ? labels.inStock : labels.soldOut)}
      </Text>
      <Group gap="4" class="flex-wrap">
        {#if ((buy as string) === "full")}
          <NumberField
            value="1"
            name={tpl("{0}-qty", id)}
            min="1"
            label={labels.qty}
            decrease={labels.decrease}
            increase={labels.increase}
          />
        {/if}
        <Button disabled={!product?.inStock} data-testid="add" onclick={() => onadd?.(product?.id)}>
          {labels.add}
        </Button>
      </Group>
      {#if ((buy as string) === "full")}
        <List tag="ul" class="flex flex-col gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          <ListItem class="flex items-center gap-2">
            <LucideIcon name="truck" size={16} />
            <Inline>
              {labels.shipping}
            </Inline>
          </ListItem>
          <ListItem class="flex items-center gap-2">
            <LucideIcon name="shield-check" size={16} />
            <Inline>
              {labels.returns}
            </Inline>
          </ListItem>
        </List>
      {/if}
    </Stack>
    {#snippet aside()}
      <ProductGallery name={product?.name} image={product?.image} thumbs={thumbs} />
    {/snippet}
  </SectionFrame>
{/if}
